description: Audits every package in a lockfile (direct and transitive) against OSV, the way Dependabot would, and says how to fix each finding: the direct upgrade on the same release line, the parent upgrade that clears a transitive one, or an override. Pass a project directory or a file path, or the file content with its name. Supported: package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, package.json, requirements.txt, poetry.lock, uv.lock, pdm.lock, pyproject.toml, Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml, go.mod, Gemfile.lock, packages.lock.json, gradle.lockfile, pom.xml, build.gradle, build.gradle.kts, libs.versions.toml, composer.lock, composer.json, requirements*.txt. Without a lockfile the tree is resolved through deps.dev. GitHub workflows (.github/workflows/*.yml, action.yml, or the directory) get an Actions check: advisories and SHA pinning.

content.description: File content, when the file is not on disk yet.

fileName.description: Name of the file in content, e.g. "package-lock.json".

path.description: Project directory or path to a lockfile/manifest.

name: check-manifest
title: Audit a whole dependency tree
